summary: Bring the published Granola CLI up to the current public API contract, including v1.5 private-note and speaker fields, paginated transcripts, audit reads, webhook endpoint management, and offline delivery verification.
reason: The archived generation spec exposes only the original folders and notes operations. Granola's live official contract now separates generated summaries from owner-written private notes, adds speaker attribution and folder filtering, requires a dedicated paginated transcript endpoint for large meetings, and exposes audit and webhook endpoint APIs. Without this patch the CLI can silently label generated summaries as private notes, lose attribution, fail with HTTP 413 on long transcripts, and leave the new administration surface unavailable to both CLI and MCP users.
validated_outcome: Unit and command-level integration tests cover schema migration and contention, private-note/summary separation, speaker attribution, transcript cursor traversal and HTTP 413 fallback, audit-key isolation and serial pagination, webhook CRUD request shapes, one-time secret preservation, delete confirmation, and replay-window/HMAC verification over the exact raw request body.
